summary: Master project finance and funding with our expert-led training course. Gain essential skills to navigate financial challenges and drive project success.
lede: Project finance training helps analysts, infrastructure managers, treasury professionals, and investment advisers assess project bankability. Participants practise building integrated cash-flow models and sizing debt against projected cash flow. They also test downside scenarios, map risk allocation, and prepare funding information for lender review.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate course suits professionals who contribute to infrastructure, energy, real estate, transport, utilities, industrial, and other capital-intensive projects. It is designed for people who need to connect project economics with debt, equity, risk allocation, and funding approval decisions.
modules: Project Cash Flow and Financial Model Architecture
Investment Approval and Financial Close Roadmap
prerequisites: No prior project finance qualification is required. You should have basic familiarity with financial statements, percentage calculations, and Excel formulas. No programming is required. The course uses Excel-based modelling and introduces Power Query and AI-assisted model review at an operational awareness level rather than a technical engineering level. A laptop with spreadsheet software is recommended for the modelling exercises.
topics: Project finance, appraisal & public investment management
